checks.summary: Strict TypeScript checking and the Solidity build passed with the independent G3 read verifier included.

A read-only Ethereum Sepolia verifier checked all three FND-05 slice artifacts, source commit reachability, historical runtime hashes and corrected runtime templates/bindings, 47 receipt statuses, spend records, terminal states, aggregate ACLs, conservation, and local-record deletion.
Formatting, typechecking, Solidity compilation, and the tracked-file and history secret scan passed.
The configured endpoint reported Ethereum Sepolia and the live NoxCompute runtime; 378 recorded writes consume 207971258466474401 wei, leaving 292028741533525599 wei within the committed allowance.

knownLimitations: Offline checks validate only static code, formatting, typing, compilation, evidence structure, and read-only chain observation. All contract, Nox, ACL, confidential-asset, lifecycle, proof, and recovery conclusions remain the referenced Ethereum Sepolia evidence.
FND-05A and FND-05B have separate evidence because below-k and pre-unwrap timeout are independently terminal requirements.
reproduction: Use Node 24.18.0 and npm 11.16.0 with the committed lockfile and local Sepolia RPC configuration.
Run npm run verify:evidence -- G3; the command is read-only and never requires or prints a private key.
Inspect evidence/sepolia/G3/FND-05-RECOVERY.json and the referenced receipt hashes without exposing recovery material.
